html:
Awarded Sydney Family Lawyers Known For Compassion and Empathy

Separating from your wife, husband or life partner can be an extremely difficult time and can leave you feeling overwhelmed and anxious about what the future holds.

The divorce process, the dividing assets or creating a parenting plan are far from straightforward and can often be emotionally charged given the circumstances. So it’s important you find a family lawyer that is considerate and patient.

At Nolan Lawyers, our Family Lawyers take the time to understand your unique situation and concerns and will guide you through the entire process with compassion and empathy.

You can be confident that your family law matter is being handled by a family lawyer with extensive experience in helping people just like you.

Why Choose Nolan Lawyers As Your Family Lawyer

It’s crucial that you find a family lawyer who makes you feel comfortable with the process. We encourage you to meet with a few family lawyers in Sydney, so that you can be confident that Nolan Lawyers is unlike any other.

Just some of the reasons why Nolan Lawyers is a great choice to help you navigate your separation or divorce include:

Focus On The Best Outcome

We focus on securing the best outcome possible for both parties through professional legal representation and will always try to avoid going to court.

Frequent & Consistent Communication

We’re always available to answer any questions and we provide frequent, consistent communication on your case’s progress.

Pragmatic Advice & Straight Answers

Our team offers pragmatic advice and straightforward answers, so you know exactly where you stand and what your options are.

A Customised Strategy

Since no two divorce cases are the same, you’ll get a detailed, customised plan based on your specific situation, so that you know what to expect throughout the process.

Compassion

You will have focused attention from a compassionate team that genuinely cares about you and your wellbeing.

Professional Representation

We provide professional representation that is focused on securing the best outcome possible.

What To Consider When Choosing A Family Law Firm

Empathy

It’s important that you find a family lawyer who has experience handling cases with compassion and empathy. We will take the time to understand your unique situation so that we can provide you with guidance and support throughout the entire process.

Straightforward Advice

Your family lawyer should help you understand the process and what’s required to achieve a fair outcome for both parties. At Nolan Lawyers, we’re transparent about the likely outcome for your situation, so you know exactly where you stand and the action you need to take.

Extensive Experience

There are many nuances to family law. We are intimate with all of them. While each individual situation is unique, our extensive family law experience means we are able to help you navigate what can be a confusing and confronting time of your life.

Convenience

Your lawyer should be available when you need to speak to them, and since there’s a lot of admin involved, it’s easier if your lawyer is close by. We always make sure we respond to any questions within a reasonable time frame and we are conveniently located in the heart of the Sydney CBD.

After completing a consultation you will walk away with:

We’re here to support you every step of the way and look forward to helping you move forward.
